title: Closed a tab by accident? Get it back in 1 second! 💻⚡ #Shorts
description:
Closed a tab by mistake? Don't panic, 3 keys bring it right back! 🙌

⌨️ Windows / Linux: Ctrl + Shift + T
🍎 Mac: Cmd + Shift + T

Press it again to keep reopening older closed tabs, one by one. Works in Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Brave, Opera and Safari.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
